title: Fake videos offered to James Fox

tellings.quote: People have already tried to sell so many videos to him. But they're not real.

plain: A documentary filmmaker named James Fox, who looks into UFO cases, has been offered many videos for sale that turned out not to be real. A Brazilian surgeon named Italo Venturelli tells Michels this, passing on what he knows of Fox's work in Brazil. He mentions it to show how much fake material circulates around such cases.
